to: Most estimates in this tree sit outside the estimates vocabulary

The vocabulary grows to fit the tree: `estimates` becomes [30m, 1h, 2h, 3h, 4h, 1d, 1w] and no task's estimate is rewritten. An estimate is a judgement somebody made; rewriting 4h to 2h would make 79 files assert a judgement never made. `scripts/estimate.mjs` already maps all three words to hours, so only `isOverSized`, which reads list POSITION, could not see them. Order is preserved and `max_unattended_estimate` stays `1d`, so no dispatch verdict changes. See ## Decision in the task.
